tasks.title: Archive and unarchive a link through the API
steps: Add the archiving and unarchiving behaviours to src/worker/decay/archive.test.ts and the archived fields to src/worker/decay/decay.test.ts, and confirm they fail

Add POST /api/v1/links/{id}/archive beside the restore route in src/worker/decay/archive.ts: in one D1 batch set state 'archived', archived_at and updated_at to now and expired_at to null, and unpin the link with the existing unpin statements so the later pin positions close up; workspace memberships are untouched
Archive only a link that is not archived; an archived link answers 200 with the link as it is and nothing is queued; an unknown or another user's link answers 404 not_found

After the write, send {user_id, link_id, refresh: true} on FETCH_QUEUE without reading or writing refresh_requested_at; when the send throws, insert a failed fetch event with the reason 'refresh before archiving could not be queued' and still answer 200 with the link

Add POST /api/v1/links/{id}/unarchive: an archived link becomes active with archived_at null and last_used_at and updated_at now, use_count unchanged and no pin; any other state answers 409 not_archived 'this link is not archived'; an unknown or another user's link 404
Return archived_at on every link view (null unless archived); for an archived link return points null, removal_at null and decay_note 'archived on <YYYY-MM-DD>: kept until deleted'

Register the routes in src/worker/app.ts, document both and the Link fields (archived_at, points nullable) in src/worker/api/openapi.ts and docs/api.md, and widen the website's Link type in src/web/api.ts (points: number | null, archived_at, state 'archived') with links.archive and links.unarchive

tasks.title: Keep an archived link archived through its refresh
steps: Add the successful and the failed refresh of an archived link to 'refreshing a link' in src/worker/fetcher/fetch.test.ts and confirm the success case fails
Make the successful fetch write in src/worker/fetcher/queue.ts keep the state 'archived' of an archived link (and its archived_at), setting 'active' for every other link as it does today
Confirm that the failed refresh path already keeps everything the archived link had, and that afterFetch and indexing still run after a successful refresh of an archived link

tasks.title: Keep archived links outside decay and liveness checks
steps: Add the archived rows to the expiry and evaluation tables of src/worker/decay/decay.test.ts, the uses and re-paste of an archived link to src/worker/links/use.test.ts, and the archived link to the scheduling and on-demand check tests of src/worker/decay/liveness.test.ts; confirm the check refusal fails

Confirm that evaluateDecay expires only active, pending and unreachable links and removes only expired ones, so an archived link is never touched, and that recordUse and the re-paste leave the state 'archived' as it is

Refuse POST /api/v1/links/{id}/check on an archived link with 409 link_archived 'archived links are not checked' before any request to its address, and keep enqueueDueChecks and isCheckable from selecting an archived link
Document the refusal in src/worker/api/openapi.ts and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Leave archived links out of the stream and in search and Ask
steps: Add the archived links to the stream, change feed, filtered list and pin tests in src/worker/links/stream.test.ts and src/worker/links/pin.test.ts, to the state tests of src/worker/search/query.test.ts and src/worker/search/search.test.ts, to src/worker/search/hybrid.test.ts and to the sources of src/worker/meaning/ask.test.ts, and confirm they fail
Accept 'archived' among the state: values (STATE_VALUES), keeping the default that leaves only expired links out of search, hybrid search, filters-only searches and Ask
Make GET /api/v1/links leave archived links out unless its state parameter names archived or any, and make listChanged leave them out

Order the links of listStream so that archived links, which have no points, come after every link with points, by last_used_at then id descending, with a cursor section of their own so that paging lists every link once; a cursor of another section or route stays invalid_cursor
Refuse POST /api/v1/links/{id}/pin of an archived link with 409 link_archived 'archived links cannot be pinned', changing no position
Update docs/api.md (state values, the stream, filters-only order, the pin refusal), src/worker/api/openapi.ts and docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: List the archived links
steps: Add the archive list behaviours to src/worker/decay/archive.test.ts beside the expired list's, and confirm they fail

Add GET /api/v1/archive in src/worker/decay/archive.ts, modelled on GET /api/v1/expired: archived links of the user by archived_at then id descending, limit 1 to 100 default 50, a keyset cursor of its own shape so that a cursor of the expired list or the stream is refused as invalid_cursor
Register it in src/worker/app.ts, document it in src/worker/api/openapi.ts and docs/api.md, and add links.archived() to src/web/api.ts, following next_cursor as links.expired() does

tasks.title: Archive a link through the MCP tool archive_link
steps: Add archive_link to TOOLS and its behaviours to 'workspaces and pins' and 'one user, one contract' in src/worker/mcp/mcp.test.ts, and confirm they fail

Add the tool archive_link with input {link_id} to src/worker/mcp/tools.ts, calling POST /links/{id}/archive through ctx.call and returning outcomeOf of the answer, with the description 'Archive a link: keep it for good, out of the stream and out of decay, after one refresh of its page.'
Describe the tool in docs/mcp.md

tasks.title: Show the archived links on an Archive page
steps: Write src/web/pages/Archive.test.tsx with the page's behaviours, update the navigation tests of src/web/pages/Expired.test.tsx and src/web/pages/Ask.test.tsx ('has an Ask tab between Tags and Expired') for the new entry, and confirm they fail

Add src/web/pages/Archive.tsx, modelled on src/web/pages/Expired.tsx: the archived links from links.archived(), each an article with the class 'archived', 'archived on <date>', Unarchive (links.unarchive, then off the list) and Delete with the undo window; a query searches with ' state:archived' added; with no links and no query, 'Nothing is archived.'
Route /archive to it and add the navigation entry 'Archive' after 'Expired' in src/web/App.tsx
Dim an article with the class 'archived' in src/web/styles.css (a lower opacity that keeps its text above the design language's contrast for muted text)

tasks.title: Archive and unarchive from cards and the detail page, and dim archived links
steps: Add the card behaviours to src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx, the Archive of a stream card to src/web/pages/Stream.test.tsx, the Archive and Unarchive of the detail page to src/web/pages/LinkDetail.test.tsx and the dimmed source to src/web/pages/Ask.test.tsx, and confirm they fail

Give CardActions onArchive and onUnarchive; a card that is not archived has Archive in its More actions menu; an archived card carries the class 'archived', shows Unarchive in place of Pin and has no Archive

On the stream, Archive sends links.archive and takes the card out of the list; on the Search and Workspace pages Archive and Unarchive send their request and replace the card with the link the API returns
In the detail page's Actions group, show Archive for a link that is not archived, and Unarchive in place of Pin for an archived one; each sends its request and shows the returned link
Give an Ask source whose link is archived the class 'archived'

Add to e2e/fake-origin.ts a control that sets the title and text one address serves, and write e2e/archive.spec.ts for the archive, refresh and unarchive flow and a test in e2e/mcp.spec.ts for archive_link followed by the Archive page
Run make doc and update docs/architecture.md for the archived state
